head: ridge
tuning: 4 inner grouped folds within 5 outer grouped folds; minimize validation RMSE
preprocessing: Fit mean and standard deviation on training rows only, separately for each fold and representation; no cohort-wide scaling or feature selection.
uncertainty: paired bootstrap by group_id across the same out-of-fold rows

models.name: panel_contextual_embedding
models.pooling: mean of model output at panel_indices_0based

models.name: all_gene_contextual_embedding
models.pooling: mean of model output across all 20010 positions, including missing-gene tokens, matching the pinned notebook all-gene protocol

bulkformer.mask_prob_note: In the pinned forward method this argument appends a scalar feature; it does not randomly mask input. Use the missing-gene fraction as in the notebook.
bulkformer.normalization: ln(TPM+1) = source log2(TPM+1) * ln(2); no re-TPM normalization.
bulkformer.context_warning: The panel pooling arm sees the full transcriptome and the 3 global summary channels, so it is not a panel-only information model.
bulkformer.pretraining_overlap: not_resolved; no claim that evaluation cell lines were absent from foundation-model pretraining

robustness_checks: modal_dose_range_subset without changing the primary labels

observed-gene-only all-gene pooling as a secondary protocol
